data.name: MARINIX Ocean Tech AS
data.description: MARINIX Ocean Tech AS is a Norwegian early-stage ocean CDR startup developing technology to stimulate marine snow formation for long-term carbon sequestration in deep-sea sediments. The company published a 2025 technical white paper outlining an €11M tokenized fundraising campaign with a targeted 2029 commercial launch. Operations are currently pre-revenue and constrained by the London Protocol's restrictions on commercial ocean CDR.
